comparison_basis: Maintained complete 123-entry crosswalk and both review-wave indexes, plus directly inspected relevant current sources; not a claim of rereading every historical article.

findings.classification: New concrete defect and alias-policy subcase
findings.title: Backend default lookup ignores Options
findings.new_evidence: SetOptions[AsymptoticExpansion,"Backend"->"Series"] is visible in Options but yields Forward quadratic output; explicit selector yields Native cubic. Primary-default candidate observations supplied.
findings.not_reclaimed: Native coverage itself and generic option-precedence work are not claimed as new.
findings.repair_boundary: Primary Backend default fixed by candidate; independent alias default ownership unresolved.

findings.title: Computed Backend key depends on specification syntax
findings.new_evidence: An option-key alias fails for a literal spec but succeeds for a computed spec; exact conflict and candidate result recorded.
findings.not_reclaimed: General native evaluation compatibility was already a goal.
findings.repair_boundary: Normalize admitted option keys before selector discovery without releasing their values.

findings.title: An applied Function is confused with an unapplied callable
findings.new_evidence: Identity-wrapped Exp[I x] is rejected while plain Exp[I x] routes natively; candidate preserves genuine callable and explicit budget controls.
findings.not_reclaimed: Complex native coverage and preservation of analytic realness policy were already required.
findings.repair_boundary: Narrow only Function occurrence tests; retain inverse, condition, object and explicit-constraint protections.

findings.title: Quadratic nested-option validation
findings.new_evidence: Measured predicate-entry counts 14,44,152,560 match d(d+3)/2 at depths4,8,16,32.
findings.not_reclaimed: Generic profiling and resource-budget proposals are not new.
findings.repair_boundary: Proposed pure classification plus normalized emission, each linear in structural nodes; not implemented by bounded candidate.

findings.title: README final status contradicts implemented automatic routing
findings.new_evidence: README introduction/source/probe show routing; final status still describes Automatic as the Package path.
findings.not_reclaimed: General documentation improvement is not a novel proposal.
findings.repair_boundary: Replacement paragraph supplied, no historical validation count promoted to current acceptance.
